title: Central Design Region
description: A server based on building a city with a variety of modded blocks and tools at your disposal!
body:
# Central Design Region
...is a half-RP, half-building server focused on building a large city, featuring a variety of buildings, shops, locations and a full railway network! The modpack and general server are managed by Jason Sika, and hosted on Modrinth by the latter and Blade0.
 
## Want to join?
Feel free to! The server comes with the modpack, if you're using the modrinth launcher. Else, download the pack on this page, drop it int to your laoucher and you're good to go! However, to reduce the risk of malicious players joining, it is **HIGHLY** suggested that you [join the discord server first](https://discord.gg/YccMYxY3px) so we know you're trying to do good! (Don't worry, we don't bite.)
